title: A channel frozen on its cold quarter: plane Poiseuille flow in the liquid layer
source: Steady conduction between walls held at −1 and +1 with the melting point at −0.5 (the front at a quarter of the gap), and plane Poiseuille flow driven by a body force between the front and the far wall, u_max = a (H − y*)² / (8 ν) at the layer's middle

quantities.reason: the steady front lies on a cell face on every grid of the refinement study (16 to 128 cells across), so each cell is wholly frozen or wholly liquid; measured below 10⁻⁶
